title: UFOs seen on Pine Ridge Reservation
place_text: Pine Ridge Indian Reservation, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I saw one I saw two on Pine Ridge.

plain: An Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson says that in the 1970s he saw UFOs on the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation in South Dakota, first one and then two. He tells it himself on the episode where he meets up again with a fellow veteran, saying only "I saw one I saw two on Pine Ridge," which would add his own sighting to his account of strange events.
